note: Machine-readable reference-sheet templates for `forge.py concept` (local image generation, 2026-11-02). Fixed clauses (CAPS) encode PRD-3 ({stance} per skeleton template: quadruped and shelled "standing on all four paws with its body horizontal, never sitting or standing upright", winged "in flight with both wings spread wide", mushroom-biped "standing upright on two legs") so image-to-3D gets clean input and stay verbatim; winged species use `creature-winged-v1` and mushroom-biped species `creature-biped-v1` (C27, 2026-11-02: creature-v1's fixed tail clause added tails to tailless bipeds and its views drifted to three-quarter and top-down for round bodies), each with its pose guide in art/source/style/pose-guides/; {fields} come from the recipe's concept.fields. `views` lists the subjects left to right as the image shows them; `size` is the generation size in pixels (each view lands about 1100-1300 px tall, above the PRD-3.1 1024 px floor). Protected spec: change under DOC-5.
